test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with an appropriate adverb.

The food is ________ good.
solution:
The correct answer is '**extremely**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**extremely**" is an adverb used to emphasize the degree or intensity of something.
 
• In this context, "**extremely**" is the most appropriate choice to describe the quality of the food.
 
• The other options: "**cautiously**," "**boldly**," and "**annually**" do not fit the context logically.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The food is extremely__ good.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Cautiously**: means in a careful or cautious way, which is not relevant here.
 
• **Boldly**: means in a confident and courageous way, which is not appropriate for describing food.
 
• **Annually**: means something that occurs every year, which does not fit the context.
